title: AlwaysOn
tagline: Livestream application build on Livepeer, deliverable in frames
description: ALWAYSON is a streaming service that allows users to create streams and share it with the world in a frame (or webpage). When user's log into ALWAYSON studio they're allowed to create a stream & begin broadcasting from the browser. Once they're browsing they can share a link of their stream which, parse by the right client can be a video frame ! I've also implemented a frame where you can view the live stream and send a "Yoink!", which is a tip transaction of some memecoin (this part isn't completely finished///)
how_its_made: I've forked @coinbase/onchainkit repository where a small frame client was implemented & made it support video. On the frame side, I also patched the @coinbase/onchaintkit utilities that allow you to format html headers in order to send the liverpeer ressources that the user creates on the ALWAYSON studio. Fairly simple, but challenging over the course of a day & a half alone ! :) But i had fun !
